request.subject: UNIT:GOBLIN:PATROL_BOAT

layers.text: Turn it into a ramshackle goblin junk-boat: the pale hull becomes dark brown planks, colour #5a3414 with #391501 shadows, patched with two riveted gunmetal grey scrap iron plates; the red sail becomes patched warm brown leather, colour #955627 with #562a0c shadows, with three stitched square patches of pale hide; the red pennant becomes a torn brown rag. Keep the boat shape, mast, size, thick black outline and art style exactly the same, on a transparent background with nothing under the hull.
